entities.summary: Natasha Walter is a British feminist writer and human rights activist. Her fifth book, Feminism for a World on Fire is published in 2026. She is the author of a novel, A Quiet Life (2016), and three other works of non-fiction: Before the Light Fades: A Family Story of Resistance, Living Dolls: The Return of Sexism, and The New Feminism. She is also the founder of the charity Women for Refugee Women.
